review.attachment: Invalid returns original schema/world/owners/recipe/debug; Built retains the operational plan and provisioned owners.
review.snapshot: None returns original owner without planned metadata flattening; Some uses ordinary application description and retained plan. No schedule or system dispatch.
review.run: Existing SP.run supplies missing and executed outcomes; all wrappers reconstruct the same retained owner fields without extra barrier or new policy.
review.authority: Public schema parameters and arbitrary affine H,C,R retained; namespace validation remains existing SP/Sch boundary. Raw constructors remain trusted.
review.limits: Not backend qualification, proof, complete debug feature coverage or performance acceptance. Wait for source-current public consumer final review before adoption.
